$comment: doc-stats config for axRange. Reproduces the counters the project's bespoke
scripts/doc-stats.py computed before the workflow-template v7 upgrade replaced it
with the generic, config-driven script (see docs/SESSION_STATE.md 2026-08-07).
Every `command` runs `{python}` -- doc-stats substitutes the interpreter running it
(the venv python the hook / pytest invoked it with) -- never bare `python3`: the
system interpreter has no pytest and cannot import axrange, so a bare python3 would
exit non-zero and silently drop the counter. Not `.venv/bin/python` either (the
pre-2026-10-19 form): since the monorepo consolidation the one venv lives at the
worktree root, not in engine/, so a path relative to this package no longer resolves.
argv-list form (not a shell string) is used throughout, so nothing here goes through
a shell.
`scenarios` is computed but deliberately has NO claim: the bespoke script counted it
the same way and never policed it either, because no doc quotes a scenario TOTAL --
the 'N archetypes' phrasings in docs/ all refer to specific subsets. Its old paths
(scenario-ai-research/stage2/scenarios, scenarios/) are dead; it now counts
../catalog/target-environments/ (twin content moved to the project root, 2026-10-20),
and returns 0 rather than failing if that directory is absent.
The `rules` claim pattern is narrow ('N catalog rules') on purpose. A broader
'N rules' would match docs/VALIDATOR.md's per-pass subset counts ('2 rules',
'53 rules') and CLAUDE.md's historical narrative counts ('89 rules', '104 rules'),
reporting drift on numbers that are correct as written.
No `limits` block: the bespoke script had no doc size budget, so adding one here
would be a new behavior, not a reproduction.
2026-09-19: CLAUDE.md is NO LONGER a policed file. It was trimmed to a lean
orientation doc that quotes no counters at all (quoted counts drifted on every
commit; the history moved to docs/DIRECTION_LOG.md). With it went the `tests`
counter + claim -- no remaining policed doc quotes a pytest total, and the counter
cost a full `pytest --collect-only` at every turn-end and commit. The `rules` claim
now binds to docs/VALIDATOR.md's lead-paragraph sum ('= N total') instead of
CLAUDE.md's old 'N catalog rules' phrasing.
NOTE: --check runs these commands at turn-end and before every commit. Review this
file as executable code. Delete it to disable drift checking entirely.

command: from axrange.ops import list_actions_and_waits, list_barriers; print(len(list_actions_and_waits()) + len(list_barriers()))
import pathlib; root = pathlib.Path('../catalog/target-environments'); print(sum(1 for p in (sorted(root.iterdir()) if root.is_dir() else []) if (p / 'scenario.yaml').is_file()))
